questions.questionText: Which of the following is the brain of a computer?
questions.explanation: CPU is commonly called the brain of a computer because it processes instructions and controls computer operations.

questions.questionText: Which language is primarily used for Android application development in this project?
questions.explanation: This project is being developed using Java with XML for Android UI.

questions.questionText: Which data structure follows the LIFO principle?
questions.explanation: Stack follows the Last In, First Out (LIFO) principle.
